tier2_formal.isolation: proposer_process required and checked by analysis.coverage_problems; in addition the OD-20 deployment (operator, escrow and secrets under another OS account or container; proposer with a read-only filesystem, no network, no ptrace) must be in place and verified by the isolation demo before any formal run: a same-account run is INVALID for the formal tier
tier2_formal.lift_decision_rule: analysis.lift_decision (digest above), all of: COMPLETE coverage (a VALID isolated candidate run on every world set the baseline ran; an invalid world set blocks the claim, it is never dropped); pooled paired primary difference with cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and significant after Holm (alpha 0.05) over the FIXED family pooled, anonymous, renamed, paraphrased, trap; every presentation's paired primary lower bound > -0.6000000000000001; every control kind's paired difference to the BEST arm on that kind has a lower bound > -0.1
rules: every arm reported for every cell
a defective task is INVALID_BENCHMARK with a new identity and a rerun from preregistration
invalid runs are reported, never aggregated, and block a lift claim
arms may be ADDED by a new identity, never removed or weakened
tier2_formal.start_condition: G0 exit (OD-3), owner-approved compute budget (OD-18), evaluator decision (OD-8), OD-20 deployment in place and verified, this identity approved (OD-19)
tier2_formal.strongest_baseline_rule: the non-adversarial arm (competence, floor or sanity role) with the highest formal-tier PRIMARY score; frozen in a baseline-freeze addendum (digest) BEFORE any Mind run
tier2_formal.world_reuse: one master root per world set, committed by sha256 before the campaign and revealed after, SHARED by every arm (paired lift) and NEVER reused across seeds, campaigns or presentations, so no proposer, stateful or not, sees a world twice; ids and names pseudonymised per run

statistics.unit_of_analysis: the WORLD SET: one campaign (one hidden world of every kind) under one (presentation, seed) master root. Every arm runs every world set once. Intervals: percentile bootstrap over world sets (2000 resamples, Random(0)). Per-cell rates are descriptive only.
